text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
We did itttt! With this, we've got all the 
ideas for the sweets sorted out!!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
YES! All that remains is to bring it to 
fruition at BAKU-SPEED!!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
Ticket-san...? You sure seem busy lately. 
Is there some kinda event goin' on?

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: Yuki-chan?! Uh, well, that's——

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
Ah~, I've been stuck trying to come up 
with a new design. So I was just asking 
those two for advice!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Y-Yeah, exactly that! Well, we're kind of 
in a rush, so gotta go!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
One day, while relaxing in the cafeteria, 
some familiar students walked over.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
——Um, so, what did you all need to see me 
for...?

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Here, this is for yooou!! It's a handmade 
chocolate nerikiri setttt!!!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
You couldn't buy any at the convenience 
store, right? I just really, really wanted 
you to taste them, so we made them!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Wha-wha-whaaat?!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
Umm... could it be that why everyone's 
been so busy lately was because of 
this...?

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
Yes, that's exactly right! We were 
recreating the sweet from your memories♪

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Day and night we worked on prototypes to 
recreate it with all our might! I believe 
it has turned out to be an absolute 
masterpiece!!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: Come on, Yuki-chan, open it up!!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, it looks just like that nerikiri~. 
It's mighty cute, and tastes downright 
delicious♪

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
I'm plumb stunned... I can really feel all 
the hard work everyone put into this...

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: Ehehe~! Then next is this one!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
Huh? This is... fluffy like snow, and 
decorated with wild flowers—

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: I-Is this my racing outfit!?

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Ehehe~, spot on!! ...You know, I've always 
thought your racing outfit was super cute, 
Yuki-chan!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
It's pure white like snow, and the sleeves 
are so fluffy! Plus the wild flowers 
blooming just like your smile! I put 
together absolutely ev-ery-thing I love 
about it!

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
So, while maintaining the pure feel of an 
untouched snowfield, I arranged the fine 
details to bring out your unique charm♪

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
Those are all the parts I love, too! To 
have it made like this for me...!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
Haaaah~~, it was truly delicious♪ My heart 
is just so full and warm!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
There's no other sweet as heartwarming as 
this! You couldn't get this at any shop.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
It's definitely... because all of 
Ticket-san and everyone's feelings were 
packed into it.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
I won't ever forget this taste for the 
rest of my life.

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Uwaaaaah!! I'm zo touched I feel like I'm 
gonna explooode toooo!!!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Ehehe... Thank you so, so much. But—

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
Keeping it a secret made me feel just a 
wee bit lonely. Next time, could I make 
them together with you?

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: ~~~!! Of cooouuuurse!!!!

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
In that case, let's come up with a new 
arranged nerikiri design! A chance to show 
off our skills♪

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Something revolutionary and Bakushin-like, 
yes!? Then let us brainstorm ideas 
immediately!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Yeah! Let's make way, waaaay more 
unforgettable sweets together!!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
To make such a wonderful thing just for 
me... Thank you truly, from the bottom of 
my heart.

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Whenever you want to eat some again, just 
say the word! I'll make you 100, or even 
1,000!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
I shall assist as well!! I will 
demonstrate mass production at Bakushin 
speed!

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
Ah, if you have any arrangement requests, 
just let me know, okay? I'm always open to 
ideas♪

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
Yes! ...Ehehe. Another sweet memory added 
to the list♪
